evidence.scope: Retains the existing 2020 apply-to-all exclusion; not a claim that all settings are unavailable.

apply_all_inputs.evidence_limit: C1/C2/G3/G4/G5 catalogues list this action. Other 2021-2026 models retain the existing platform-family inference; acknowledgement never proves that individual destination settings match.

evidence.scope: applyToAllInput picture/done values in C1, C2, G3, G4 and G5 catalogues.
Existing 2021+ operation support, now explicit and bounded to reviewed years.

panel_protection.evidence_limit: Write-only Luna methods on 2020 and newer OLEDs, reached through the alert bridge. Neither the settings service nor the calibration API reads the state back, so a dispatched request is never verified and a run must re-enable both controls itself. A reviewed internal platform is still required before anything is sent.

evidence.scope: setTemporalPeakControl and setGlobalStressReduction {enable} on 2020+ OLEDs; three independent open-source LG control tools expose the same pair.
Calibrators disable TPC/GSR (ASBL) for the duration of a session because static patterns are dimmed after roughly a minute; not a claim about any individual set.
